title: Lionel Messi's animated show shows its first teaser
summary:
Soccer star Lionel Messi is helping to make an animated show. It is called Messi and the Giants. It is a Disney sports-fantasy series, and Messi is one of its executive producers, which means he helps guide how the show is made. The show shared its first teaser on Friday, Oct. 2, at San Diego Comic-Con Málaga in Spain.

The show's theme song is "Vamos, Vamos, Vamos." It was recorded by singer Luck Ra, who has topped the Billboard Argentina Hot 100 chart four times. His song is in the teaser. More than 3,000 fans in Hall M got a first look at the show's story, characters and music.

The story follows Leo, a 12-year-old boy who becomes trapped in an alternate reality ruled by giants. To return home, he must "compete in high-stakes, soccer-like battles using powerful 'orbs,' defeat legendary giants, and restore the fractured realms of 'Iko,'" according to the press release. Leo cannot use the world's code powers to supercharge his game. Instead, he relies on his real strengths: skill, teamwork and determination. The story is an underdog adventure about courage, perseverance and believing in yourself. Argentinian actor Milo Burgess-Webb will voice Leo.

The series is set to premiere around the world on Disney+ in summer 2027. Disney Channel is also scheduled to air it in the U.S.
